_comment: Every tunable number lives here. Nothing risk-related is hardcoded.

account._note: Account type CHANGED from 'cash' to 'limited_margin' on 27 Aug 2026. Limited margin allows trading unsettled proceeds immediately, which removes the good-faith-violation risk the original design guarded against. UNVERIFIED: whether pattern-day-trader rules now apply to this account - they do not on a cash account but may on a margin one, and under $25k that would mean a 90-day restriction after four day trades in five business days. Confirm with Robinhood before relaxing never_exit_same_session below.

sizing._note: Fractional buys via dollar_amount market orders. Whole shares were the plan until live quotes showed 0 of 8 typical candidates were affordable at this account size (cheapest, NKE at $38.59, exceeded $37.94 buying power). Revisit whole shares near $250 equity.

stops._note: Synthetic only. Fractional positions cannot carry a resting stop order (fractional requires type=market; a stop is type=stop_market/stop_limit). The 15-minute poll IS the risk control -- it needs a dead-man's switch.

exits._never_exit_same_session_note: Kept ON. The original reason (cash-account settlement) no longer applies, but the PDT question is open and the rule is cheap insurance either way.

excluded_symbols._note: Pre-existing holdings the harness must never touch. Empty once liquidated.

execution._note: Order placement and the stop poll run as Claude scheduled tasks, because the Robinhood connector is authenticated to Claude and unreachable from a standalone launchd script. Consequence: protection exists ONLY while the Claude app is open during market hours.
execution._analysis_note: Ingest, transcription and ranking need no broker access, so they stay on launchd and run regardless.
